newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 388 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 388 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 388 contracts, compared with 1,108 contracts traded overnight Monday.
There were 39 wheat, 173 corn, 160 soybean, 14 soymeal and two corn puts traded.
In overnight trading, corn was steady to 1/2 cent higher, wheat 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 cents higher, soybeans 1/2 to two cents higher and soymeal steady to $0.80 per ton higher.
